---
name: implement
description: Implement an active songbook ticket as a tested vertical slice.
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, the relevant ticket in `docs/tickets.md`, `docs/spec.md`, and applicable guidance in `docs/agents/`. Identify the ticket ID and acceptance criteria before editing. Implement the smallest complete vertical slice, preserving existing conventions and user changes. Verify with the narrowest useful executable checks, then broader checks when appropriate. Mark acceptance criteria complete only when verified, and summarize changed files, validation evidence, and remaining risks. Do not commit unless explicitly requested.
